profile.name: Renaldi Saputra
profile.title: Graphic & Motion Designer
profile.about_en: I am a graphic and motion designer. I work on 3D product motion, blocking and previz in Blender, AI-driven commercials, and design for social media and print.
profile.about: Saya desainer grafis dan motion designer. Saya mengerjakan product motion 3D, blocking dan previz di Blender, TVC berbasis AI, sampai desain untuk sosial media dan materi cetak.

works.title: Katalog Merch: Warehouse Buitenzorg
works.desc: Desain katalog pre-order kaos oversize 4 halaman 9:16 (cover, front, on body, size chart). Tema dark fantasy gothic: latar hitam bertekstur, glow bulan merah, dan tipografi blackletter mengikuti artwork prajurit undead dan anak warehouse.
works.desc_en: A 4-page 9:16 pre-order catalog for an oversized tee (cover, front, on body, size chart). Dark fantasy gothic treatment: textured black, red moon glow and blackletter type to match the undead warrior artwork.

works.title: Katalog Merch: SPX South Jabo Campaign 11.11
works.title_en: Merch Catalog: SPX South Jabo Campaign 11.11
works.desc: Desain katalog pre-order kaos 4 halaman 9:16 bertema One Piece: latar poster WANTED, aksen oranye SPX, dan kartu krem ala kertas buronan. Dilengkapi versi motion 25 detik dengan musik original dan transisi sesuai beat.
works.desc_en: A 4-page 9:16 One Piece-themed pre-order tee catalog: WANTED-poster background, SPX orange accents and parchment cards. Comes with a 25-second motion version with original music and beat-synced transitions.

works.title: Katalog Merch: Lex ID Heroes Late Game

works.desc_en: A 4-page 9:16 pre-order catalog for an oversized tee (cover, front, on body, size chart) for a Lex ID merch drop. Dark treatment with red-orange accents to match the thrash-metal grim reaper artwork.

works.title: Pitch Deck: Company Profile Video Proposal

works.title: Pitch Deck & Motion Proposal: Bentala Studio × Basheera
works.desc: Desain deck penawaran dan versi motion untuk proposal company profile video Basheera Projects dari Bentala Studio. Layout bersih dengan aksen biru, kartu bernomor untuk alur kerja, dan transisi halus antar slide.

works.title: Top Banner: Kenaikan Harga Kirim ke UK, US & Kanada
works.desc: Top banner aplikasi Master Bagasi untuk mengumumkan kenaikan harga pengiriman ke Inggris, Amerika Serikat, dan Kanada mulai 1 November. Kabar harga naik dikemas jadi visual yang ceria dan mendorong pengguna segera kirim: maskot koper MB versi musim dingin meluncur di atas pita jalan, bendera ketiga negara naik bertingkat dengan panah ke atas, dan teks 3D "1 November" yang searah dengan angle HP. Palet mengikuti warna maskot: oranye dengan aksen biru.
